sentence_stem: Although the statute had been amended several times,
correct_completion: the court still applied the original interpretation.
full_sentence: Although the statute had been amended several times, the court still applied the original interpretation.
acceptable_variants: the court nevertheless applied the original interpretation.
the judges still relied on the earlier precedent.

options.text: so the appeal was dismissed without review.
options.why_wrong: 'So' introduces a result, but 'although' sets up a contrast, so this result does not fit the connector.

options.text: because the judges had recused themselves.
options.why_wrong: 'Because' introduces a cause. 'Although' requires a contrast, so this clause clashes with the connector.

options.text: the clerk filed the documents in March.
options.why_wrong: This adds a procedural detail but does not express the contrast that 'although' requires.

options.text: the court still applied the original interpretation.

explanation: After 'although', the clause must contrast with the first part of the sentence. Amendments normally suggest a change in interpretation, so retaining the original reading completes the contrast. Spanish speakers may be tempted to use a cause connector here because the two ideas are closely linked, but English 'although' always marks concession.
translation: Aunque el estatuto había sido modificado varias veces, el tribunal siguió aplicando la interpretación original.
